# Vendored community policies

Snapshot of `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`, and `SECURITY.md` from
[amalgamator-ai/amalgamator](https://github.com/amalgamator-ai/amalgamator).

`make prepare-community` prefers the amalgamator checkout (CI sparse clone or
`sources/amalgamator`). This directory is the offline fallback.
